book.name: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan
book.title: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan Mulai neme Manetualain Ana tao lalai no daebafok

content: Noh ma Yafet numbu-sadu nala
Basa faa tuak, boe ma Noh ana nala, hambu numbu-sadu kala, fo ndia numbu-saduk neme Sem, Yafet ma Ham mai.

Yafet numbu-sadu nala, sila: Gomer, Magok, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek ma Tiras. Esa-esako no ndia dedeꞌan, sila leon, ma sila dae hehelin. Gomer numbu-sadu nala, sila: Askenas, Rifat ma Togarma. Yawan numbu-sadu nala, sila: Elisa, Tarsis, hataholi Kitim asa, ma Dodanim, fo ala leo lai tasibifi kala.
Ham numbu-sadu nala
Ham numbu-sadu nala, sila: Kus, Misram, Put, ma Kanaꞌan.
Kus numbu-sadu nala, sila: Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Raema ma Sabteka. Raema numbu-saꞌdu nala, Syeba no Dedan.
Kus ana touanan, ndia Nimrod, fo malangga musu palani makasosoak.

Ndia lanin neme LAMATUAK mai, losa ndia boe oo, dadik manasombu banda fo ana seli. Huu ndia, de hataholi la lateme kokolak lae, “Ela ana dadik mana sombu malelak leo Nimrod, fo ana hambu ndia ana selin neme LAMATUAK mai.”
Sososan, ndia dae babaꞌen mulai neme Babel, Erek Akad, ma Kalne. Sila basa sala lai Sinear
Neme ndia mai, ana koasa seluk Asyur. Basa boe ma, ana nambadedei kota Niniwe, Rehobot-Ir, Kala,
ma Resen fo nai Niniwe no Kala laladan. Basa sala, kota inahuuk mesan.
Misraim numbu-sadu nala, fo sila, hataholi Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naftuhim,
Patrusim, Kasluhim, ma Kaftorim. Hataholi Kasluhim ndia, na, sila hataholi Filistin asa bei-baꞌi nala.
Kanaꞌan, ana kaꞌan, ndia Sidon. Kanaꞌan boe oo, ana dadik neu hataholi Het,
Yebusi, Amori, Girgasi,
Hiwi, Arki, Sini,
Arwadi, Semari, ma Hamati sala bei-baꞌi nala. Kanaꞌan numbu-sadu nala, latanggenggelak losa dook,
losa sila dae too nala, mulai neme Sidon mai, nakandoo neni Gerar neu, losa nai Gasa. Neme ndia mai, neni Sodom, Gomora, Adma, ma Seboim, losa nai Lasa.
Sila basa sala ndia, Ham numbu-sadu nala. Esa-esak no ndia dedeꞌan, ma leon, ma dae hehelin.
Sem numbu-sadu nala
Yafet kaꞌan Sem, ana dadik hataholi Eber asa bei-baꞌi nala.
Sem numbu-sadu nala, sila: Elam, Asyur, Arpaksad, Lud ma Aran.
Aran numbu-sadu nala, sila: hataholi Us, Hul, Geter, ma Mas.
Arpaksad anan, Sela. Sela anan, Eber.
Eber ana hambu ana tou-anak dua. Kaꞌak naꞌde Pelek, (fo ndandaan nae, ‘latanggenggelak’), huu faik ndia, hataholi la latanggelak nai daebafok. Faꞌdin, nade Yoktan.
Yoktan numbu-sadu nala, sila: Almodad, Selef, Hasar-Mawet, Yera,
Hadoram, Usal, Dikla,
Obal, Abimael, Syeba,
Ofir, Hawila, ma Yobab. Sila basa sala ia, Yoktan numbu-sadu nala.
Sila mamana leleon ndia, mulai neme Mesa, nakandoo losa nai Sefar, fo ndia mamana lete kala lai dulu.
Sila basa sala sila, Sem numbu-sadu nala. Esa-esak no ndia dedeꞌan, sila leon, ma sila dae hehelin.
Basa sila, Noh numbu-sadu nala, esa-esako no ndia leo hehelin. Faik fo faa tuak nateꞌe, sila ndia latanggenggelak tao lahenu daebafok.

footnotes.text: Kus, na ndia ‘Etiopia’. Misraim, na ndia ‘Masir’. Makahulun, ala foi nusa kala tungga sila nade nala.
Sinear ndia, na Babel nade feꞌen. Hatematak ia, mamanak ndia nai Iran no Iraq.
Hataholi malelak luma lae Eber ndia, na, ndia ‘Ibrani’.
